title: DelegationEventContract
description: Authoritative contract schema for observable subagent delegation events in AcademicSuite (Phase 23). Enforces the 8 mandatory fields: parent_agent, child_agent, task_id, timestamp, objective, input_artifacts, output_artifacts, status.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this delegation event (e.g. EVT-DEL-20260920-001).

event_type.description: Canonical lifecycle stage of the delegated subagent.

child_agent.description: The specialist worker subagent (e.g. statistics-agent, data-agent, academic-writer).

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the delegated task contract (e.g. TSK-2026-CH4-001).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the observable delegation event.

objective.description: Unambiguous scholarly or operational objective assigned to the child agent.

input_artifacts.description: List of input datasets, artifacts, or parameters provided to the child agent.

output_artifacts.description: List of expected or produced deliverable files on disk.

status.description: Observable status of the child subagent at this event milestone.

details.description: Additional execution telemetry, exit code, error messages, or statistics.
